issues.legal_issue: An executing court may determine under Section 47 of the Code of Civil Procedure objections by a decree party’s successor in interest concerning execution of the decree and the parties’ respective rights in the property.
Procedural reliance on inconsistent provisions for execution objections cannot defeat substantive rights where the defect does not warrant dismissal of the objections.
A decree in a later partition suit cannot be executed so as to displace property already allotted and delivered under an earlier final partition decree.
Execution of a partition decree must await determination of whether the land designated in the final decree overlaps with land previously allotted and delivered under an earlier decree.
